lastCompletedStory.title: Add resolveIssueId helper (string or numeric issueNumber, never <prefix>-0)

nextStoryContext: US-002 adds an optional issueId?: string field to MergeWatchState (src/release/merge-watch.ts) and a stashIssueIdInMergeWatch helper. The resolveIssueId helper from US-001 is now available at src/issues/resolve-id.ts and is ready to wire into finalizeCycleClose (US-004). Reminder: readMergeWatchState must still return null for issueId-only files (no prNumber) to keep the sidecar inert.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure in-house helper; no external library exercised.
